Ram Temple Donation Theft Case Under Investigation

An investigation is underway into the alleged theft of funds from the Ram Temple in Ayodhya. A Special Investigation Team (SIT) has identified a temple employee as the prime accused, while some employees have resigned citing work conditions. Petitions seeking a CBI probe into the matter are scheduled to be heard by the Supreme Court.
